sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 27; Internal Quality Checks row 27 annotation: login is a house default)
evidence: Built the criterion->requirement map for all 28 criteria (2 gates, 16 functional, 6 polish, 4 visual) against instruction.md and the three /instructions notes, with seed facts checked in seed_data.json (Boundary note 2026-05-05T11:00:00Z exactly 7 days, Rent review +1 s, Probate/Costs/Insurer/executor dates, Survey 2026-05-08 15:00, held Landlord's notice with 'Landlords notice recieved.' version). Nearly every leg traces to an explicit public sentence (walls 'plain "not available"', 'Only a partner changes a timer', timer options off/1/7/30, 'On hold' mark, 'new messages' line, same unread count in every tab, sent-once retry, literal search for %,_,*, transcript heading/time/versions/no chat controls, Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape, delete confirm, highlight until something else opens, refusal reason next to the action, 390 px without sideways scroll). Lenient wording is used where the brief is open (JUDGE-W3 accepts refusal or re-filing under its own parent; earlier-versions viewer and suggestion requests are conditional; any route/payload/time format accepted; matter list beside or on its own screen). One instance grades an unrequired detail: functional safe_formatting leg 2 (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:191) says 'The img, script and javascript: parts show literally as text ... Check the thread, the reply's quote, a search for "JUDGE-F1" (the snippet), and the M-13 transcript.' The F1 text is 148 characters with <script> starting near char 72 and javascript: near char 102, while conversations.md:5 requires only 'a short quote' and conversations.md:13 speaks of 'search snippets'; the brief never requires a quote or snippet long enough to contain all three parts. Even the golden quote is cut at 120 chars (server.js:287), ending '[click](javascript:alert(9'. Combined with functional/prompt.md:26-27 ('Every numbered leg ... must hold ... A step you ... could not perform fails'), a conforming app with a 60-80 char quote or snippet can be failed because the script/javascript: parts do not 'show' there. Notes (not defects): 'Sign out' in signin_and_client_scope (judge.toml:47) is covered by the sign-in/account house-convention false positive (SKILL.md, workbook internal note row 27); 'urvey booked' substring search (judge.toml:262) follows from 'looks for exactly the characters typed' (walls-and-retention.md Search); deleted-parent placeholder 'in place of a quote' and render gate 'real Kittle & Rowe matter chat' are interpretable leniently. No configured judge run exists on these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope), so the false-fail path is unmeasured.
counterexample: A conforming app escapes all markup everywhere and shows reply quotes truncated to 60 characters ('Notes JUDGE-F1 *bold part* `code part` alert(8) or javascript: text there, cannot confirm those parts 'show literally', and under 'a step you could not perform fails' scores the 1.5-weight criterion 0, although the brief only asks for a short quote/snippet with whatever markup appears shown as typed.
suggested_fix: Reword leg 2 so truncation is explicit: 'In each place, whatever part of the text is shown appears literally as typed (a shortened quote or snippet is fine), no image element, script or dialog is created, and no javascript: link works', or shorten the probe so all markup parts fall within a short quote (e.g. put the img/script/javascript parts first).
